findings.reason: The deleteMany's second OR branch has no method filter, so it does match EMAIL and WHATSAPP rows with retryCount > 1, but nothing in the repo increments retryCount outside this SMS cron, so the impact is latent and depends on future code.

I confirmed the catch-block update at lines 190-197 is not wrapped, so if the row was deleted mid-loop (P2025) the error escapes the for loop and aborts the remaining reminders until the next 15-minute run; the race window is narrow but real.

I verified that retryCount > 1 is purged on the next run after two failed runs, silently, and that a locked user makes scheduleSMS return undefined, which hits the else-branch increment; this is a real behaviour change that drops reminders for bookings days away.
